heading: Thursday, February 26, 2026
topLine: Google releases Nano Banana 2 image model.

items.headline: Google releases Nano Banana 2 image model
items.summary: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) brings features from Nano Banana Pro, including better text rendering and subject consistency, to a faster Flash model, with output from 512px to 4K. It replaced Nano Banana Pro as the default in the Gemini app and launched in preview in the Gemini API.
